KanjiVG kana stroke paths

Original work: KanjiVG
Original author: Ulrich Apel
Source snapshot:
https://github.com/KanjiVG/kanjivg/tree/bd13ffbcc9d85cb86ae98bbbf001d9069220b901

Modifications made for Kana Mori:
Ordered SVG path `d` values were extracted for the 162 hiragana and
katakana characters used by the application. Other SVG metadata was removed.

The derived stroke dataset is distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. The surrounding
Kana Mori application is a collection; this notice does not change the license
of unrelated application code.
